content.title: Photos: North Carolina gives up a big lead and falls to VCU in NCAA Tournament
content.text: North Carolina's Seth Trimble (7), Isaiah Denis (5) and head coach Hubert Davis walk off the court after VCU’s 82-78 overtime victory over UNC in the first round of the NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament at Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, S.C., Thursday, March 19, 2026. ehyman@newsobserver.com The No. 6-seeded North Carolina Tar Heels blew a 19-point lead to lose to No. 11-seeded Virginia Commonwealth 82-78 in OT on Thursday at Bon Secours Arena in Greenville, S.C. This was the largest first-round comeback in NCAA Tournament history.UNC led by as many as 19 points with 15 minutes remaining in the game but allowed he Rams cut their deficit to two with a 16-3 run over a five-minute period late in the game. VCU’s guards Nyk Lewis, Michael Belle and Hill — scored all of VCU’s points in that run, North Carolina's Henri Veesaar (13) walks off the court after VCU’s 82-78 overtime victory over UNC in the first round of the NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament at Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, S.C., Thursday, March 19, 2026.
